info.title: ScreenshotAPI
info.description: Hosted ScreenshotAPI capture endpoints, authentication, request options, and response envelopes.

post.description: Requires screenshot:write. Accepts a JSON body of at most 256 KiB. Returns capture data on 200 or a job handle on 202, including when sync is true. A query mode=async overrides the body's sync flag. Successful viewport images cost 1 credit, full-page images 2, and PDFs 3. Use the same key and identical request on an idempotent retry.

get.description: No API key required. Readiness checks Redis, database connectivity, unpaused queue processing, and available worker heartbeats. A healthy response is not a latency guarantee.

503.description: Service is not ready; some diagnostics can be absent on an outage.

post.description: Outbound POST to the callback specified in your capture request. Verify the exact raw body using HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + '.' + rawBody), enforce timestamp tolerance, and deduplicate delivery. Callback delivery is independent of rendering.

200.description: Return a 2xx status after safely accepting the event.

bearerAuth.description: Active sf_live_ API key with endpoint-specific scopes. Keep this credential server-side.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS target. Bare hostnames are normalized to HTTPS. Private network destinations are blocked by the hosted service.

viewport.description: CSS-pixel viewport and output density. A device preset takes precedence over an explicit viewport.

device.description: Supported preset identifier; takes precedence over viewport settings.

full_page.description: Capture the scrollable page. Successful full-page images cost 2 credits.

full_page_algorithm.description: Section capture is the default. Native uses the alternative full-page path.

full_page_scroll_delay.description: Delay between full-page scroll steps, in milliseconds.

full_page_scroll_by.description: Full-page scroll step in CSS pixels.

format.description: Output format. Full-page by_sections PDFs package rendered pixels; native and viewport PDFs use browser PDF export. PDFs cost 3 credits and cannot be combined with selector.

quality.description: JPEG or WebP encoding quality; does not control PNG encoding.

delay.description: Additional wait after page settlement, in milliseconds.

timeout.description: Capture/navigation time budget in milliseconds, independent of the synchronous HTTP wait budget.

wait_for_selector.description: CSS readiness selector to wait for before capture.

wait_for_content.description: Enable content-readiness waiting for dynamic pages.

fail_if_incomplete.description: Reject detected incomplete or loading-shell captures.

fail_if_content_missing.description: Required text markers, trimmed before validation.

fail_if_content_contains.description: Disallowed text markers, trimmed before validation.

min_capture_height.description: Minimum output height accepted by quality checks.

min_capture_bytes.description: Minimum encoded output bytes accepted by quality checks.

dark_mode.description: Emulate a dark preference when color_scheme is not explicitly set.

locale.description: Browser locale; overrides the region locale if supplied.

timezone.description: IANA browser timezone; overrides the region timezone if supplied.

region.description: Country-aligned locale/timezone preset and expected egress country. Does not provision a managed proxy.

proxy.description: Caller-supplied public proxy endpoint and optional authentication.

verify_egress.description: Verify observed egress country when a region is requested.

selector.description: Capture the first matching visible element. Not supported with PDF.

remove_selectors.description: Remove matching nodes; can affect layout.

custom_css.description: CSS injected into the target page.

custom_js.description: JavaScript executed in the target page.

headers.description: Headers sent to the target, not credentials for the ScreenshotAPI request. Keep target credentials private.

sync.description: Wait for immediate completion when true; a slow or queued capture still returns 202. The mode=async query overrides this field.

cache_ttl.description: Maximum capture reuse age in seconds. Zero requests a fresh capture; not a storage-lifetime guarantee.

store.description: Shared engine storage flag. Hosted REST output still requires a downloadable artifact.

webhook.description: Public HTTPS callback on port 443 with a 16–256 character signing secret. Delivered after terminal settlement.
